messages.subject: Purchase Milkweed Insulating Non-Woven Batting
messages.text:
Hello,

 

 
I am interested in buying milkweed batting to make a "duvet" insert. I am looking to purchase either a single 5m piece or 2 x 2.5m pieces?

 

 
If that's an option, what would be the total cost of the fabric?

 
Can I pick it up somewhere in Montreal or Quebec City. Or have it delivered?

 

 
Thank you!

 

 
Pascale

messages.subject: Re: Purchase Milkweed Insulating Non-Woven Batting
messages.text:
Hello Pascale,
 

 Thank you for your interest in our products.
 

 Following your message, please note that we can sell you 5 meters of milkweed insulating, either in one piece or split into two. It depends on what suits you best. You just need to specify your preference in the note that you can add to your order at the basket level on our website.
 

 The price for 5 meters of insulation would be $212.65, taxes included, and delivery is free for all orders of $100 or more. If you prefer, you can pick up your order at our production workshop in Quebec City or at the Les Défricheuses store in Montreal.
 

 If you wish, we can create the order for you and send you the invoice to pay.
 

 We are waiting to hear from you!
 

 Warmly,
 __
 Véronique 
 Customer Service 
 Lasclay
